guideH2: How tax on your pay works in Australia
tfnText: Give your employer your TFN. Without it, tax is withheld at the top rate of 47%. You can apply for a TFN for free on the ATO website.
residencyText: If you live in Australia, or study here for 6 months or more, you are usually an Australian resident for tax. Residents pay no tax on the first $18,200 of income each year; foreign residents pay tax from the first dollar. Use the ATO's residency tool if you are unsure.
tftText: Claim it from one employer only, usually your main job. If you have a second job, more tax is taken from it so you don't end up with a tax bill.
superText: Your employer must pay 12% of your ordinary earnings into a super fund for your retirement, on top of your pay. Since 1 July 2026 it must arrive within 7 business days of each payday.
medicareText: Most residents pay a 2% Medicare levy, which funds the public health system. It is included in the tax withheld from your pay.
returnText: The tax year runs from 1 July to 30 June. Lodge your tax return by 31 October, or later if you use a registered tax agent. From the 2026–27 tax return, everyone with work income gets a $1,000 deduction for work expenses without needing receipts.
popularIntro: Main job, tax-free threshold claimed, {year} tax rates.
disclaimer: General information only, not tax advice. Not affiliated with the Australian Taxation Office. Figures use the ATO's withholding formulas for pays from 1 July 2026.

ratesIntro: Tax rates for Australian residents for {year} (1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027). The 2% Medicare levy is added on top.
changesText: The rate on income between $18,201 and $45,000 fell from 16% to 15% on 1 July 2026 and will fall to 14% from 1 July 2027. From 2026–27 everyone with work income gets a $1,000 standard deduction for work expenses, and from 2027–28 the working Australians tax offset takes up to $250 off the tax of people with work income.
offsetsH2: Offsets, Medicare levy and study loans
litoText: Low income tax offset: up to $700, reducing from $37,500 of income and gone at $66,667.
medicareRateText: Medicare levy: 2% of taxable income, less on low incomes.
helpText: HELP and other study loan repayments start at {threshold} of income in {year}.
foreignText: Foreign residents pay tax from the first dollar and can't claim the tax-free threshold or the low income tax offset.
superRateText: Super guarantee: 12% of ordinary earnings, paid by your employer on top of your pay.
